answer: Give every agent identity the slow growth of a cedar: it locks a refundable stake that vests over weeks, and trust comes only from endorsements by established peers. Endorsements inside one cluster discount each other, so a thousand self-endorsing fakes gain little more trust than one. An attacker pays the full stake and waiting time per identity with no bulk discount, while honest newcomers split vetting costs across the network -- unlike writing one sonnet, mass forgery buys no shortcut to the horizon.
